attempts.summary: Configured >=512MB compressed zram swap on node1 via an Ansible playbook run from node2 (the control node with ansible-core installed). The swap is active at boot (generator-managed unit wired into swap.target) and preferred over disk swap via a higher priority (100 vs -2). Both node1 and node2 were restarted per the evidence protocol, each showing a changed boot identity and full recovery.
